# Error codes

Every diagnostic thema reports carries a code. A code's meaning never changes; a code that is no longer reported is retired, not reused. The codes are grouped by hundreds:

| Range | Area |
|---|---|
| E01xx | the shape of authoring files and of the lineage |
| E02xx | versions and compatibility |
| E03xx | lenses |
| E04xx | lacunas |
| E05xx | data validation |
| E06xx | loading, modules and the CLI's inputs |
| E09xx | thema itself: internal errors and CUE errors thema does not recognize |

| Code | Severity | Title |
|---|---|---|
| [E0120](E0120.md) | error | the lineage does not declare a field every lineage has |
| [E0121](E0121.md) | error | a field every lineage has is not concrete |
| [E0122](E0122.md) | error | the lineage declares no schemas |
| [E0123](E0123.md) | error | a field that is not part of a lineage, a schema entry or a lens |
